s049.sec81.u0: Welcome... Oh? I haven't seen you before, customer. From far away?
s049.sec81.u1: I'm from the city. Well, from another world, originally.
s049.sec81.u2: So you understand what I say.
s049.sec81.u3: Well, sure... oh, wait, that's not normal, is it...
How do you run a shop if no one understands
s049.sec81.u4: Oh, experience and gestures. But it is hard at times. Sales just won't pick up...
s049.sec81.u6: Business has been slow lately. The customers who used to come have stopped coming...
s049.sec81.u7: That must be because of the trouble on the island...
s049.sec81.u8: So there's something I'd like your help with.
s049.sec81.u10: How would you like to work in my shop?
s049.sec81.u12: Just half a day. Your pay goes up with the sales. You understand the language, and I've a feeling you have a knack for it.
s049.sec81.u13: Hmm. Don't blame me if you lose money...
s049.sec81.u14: Don't worry about that. Whatever happens, I'll learn something from it. It's about eight hours. Will you do it?
s049.sec81.u15: I see... that can't be helped. When you have time, please come back.
s049.sec81.u16: Oh, ready to do the part-time job?
s049.sec82.u0: Well, we're just past the halfway mark.
s049.sec82.u1: Hmm, the way things are going... we may not make a profit. Keep at it.
s049.sec82.u2: Well, sales are going fairly well. We may turn a profit after all.
s049.sec82.u3: My word! Sales this good are a rare thing. Let's keep it up to the end.
s049.sec82.u4: Well, it seems the time is up.
s049.sec82.u5: Hmm, I thought you'd do a little better. Well, some days luck just isn't with you... Please help me again.
s049.sec82.u7: Yes, sales came out just as I expected. But for someone of your ability, that's still not enough. Please help me again.
s049.sec82.u9: What can I say but splendid.
Your wits, your drive and your character are
s049.sec82.u11: Forgive me. I was testing you, to see if you're made of the stuff to save the island. Being strong in battle matters, of course.
s049.sec82.u12: But I believed strength alone wouldn't save the island. It takes wits and courage too.
s049.sec82.u13: I'm sorry I kept that from you.
s049.sec82.u15: Far beyond what I imagined. From now on, I'll help you with everything I've got.
s049.sec82.u16: Then you'll come to the city! Hm? What about this shop?
s049.sec82.u17: Oh, I can build a shop anytime. This one has done its job.
